name: Beeline: a press on a main aetheryte icon is left to the game's own teleport (and back the same way)

steps.msg: precondition: on foot next to the Yedlihmad aetheryte in Thavnair. Costs two teleport fees (~70 gil each).
on foot before the test (the previous trip may have ended on the mount, in the air)

steps.mark: Ctrl+click on Palaka's Stand's aetheryte icon (world 404, -247)

steps.waitFor: event:\[Beeline\] On an aetheryte \(Palaka's Stand\): leaving it to the game's teleport
steps.msg: Beeline should leave the aetheryte to the game
Beeline must not start a trip of its own
the game's own teleport should happen
you should arrive at Palaka's Stand

steps.mark: back: Ctrl+click on the Yedlihmad aetheryte icon (196, 628)

steps.waitFor: event:\[Beeline\] On an aetheryte \(Yedlihmad\): leaving it to the game's teleport

steps.msg: the game should teleport you back
you should be back at Yedlihmad
